readerCopy.body: A want you have been treating like a problem may become impossible to separate from the decision about what you actually want next. When Lilith conjuncts the North Node, an unconventional relationship, career move, boundary, lifestyle, creative direction, or refusal you kept private can start changing the plan itself. Wanting something does not automatically make it wise, but hiding the want makes honest planning impossible. Put it into the decision and see what has to change once what you want is no longer being edited out.
